title: Direct sign-in door answers 400 when an RP-initiated logout returns to it with state
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ② a follow-up to objectstack#35106 (`afterSignOut: 'identity-provider'`), found by the contract review of its consumer, objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4899 (non-blocking note 2). Reader: the `domain:server` lane (plugin-auth direct sign-in). Dedupe: `direct sign-in state`, `sign-in/direct VALIDATION_ERROR` — none.

## Finding

When `/sign-out` is given a `state`, the OIDC provider appends `?state=` to the post-logout redirect (`@better-auth/oauth-provider` end-session). The direct sign-in door (`direct-sign-in.ts`) accepts a closed query set, `callbackURL` only, so it answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` instead of starting the authorize.

The shipped Console sends no `state`, so the UI cannot reach this today, and it fails closed: the person stays signed out. A host or client that does send `state`, as the OIDC spec allows, breaks the return.

## Done when

The door either accepts and ignores (or round-trips) `state`, or the `afterSignOut` contract documents that callers must not send one. A test pins the choice.
